Identify the option that arranges the following major policy moves by the Union Government in chronological order of their announcement.
1. Expansion of PLI (Production-Linked Incentive) Scheme – A move to extend incentives to more sectors, boosting domestic manufacturing and exports
2. Introduction of Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) Framework – A policy aimed at enhancing digital governance and promoting seamless digital transactions

4. FDI Policy Reforms 2024 – Amendments to foreign direct investment (FDI) rules to attract more global investments into key sectors
